items.description: Follow-ups surfaced by Wave 0 MCP playtest 2026-05-30: (1) Proto bump: web is on rpg-api-protos@3a5e2bc47447; ResourceChanged was added in proto PR #168. Bump the web to include ResourceChanged so the dispatcher can handle it and RageCharges display can be built. (2) Double-stream event issue: StatusApplied and EntityDamaged appear twice — investigate useEncounterStream2 buffering. (3) Attack miss silence: no user feedback when TakeAction(attack) misses. File issues for all three.
PR #379 docs/honest-status-snapshot — bootstrap doc tree (architecture/overview.md, data-model.md, components/*.md, how-to/*.md). Extended by this session.

PR #377 fix/376-room-revealed-all-rooms — calls allRoomsFromEncounterState in handleRoomRevealed instead of roomFromEncounterState. Paused pending confirmation that RoomRevealed events reach browser (issue #380).

PR #378 test/room-reveal-transforms — extracts 5 transform functions from LobbyView.tsx to utils/encounterStateTransforms.ts with 25 tests. Paused alongside #377. IMPORTANT: these 25 tests are NOT on main — the status.md claim about commit 15f232e merging to main was incorrect.
PR #370 fix/hex-entity-equipment-fallback — resolves weapons/shields from itemId fallback when equipment data is missing. Independently useful, unblocked by stream issue.

Issue #380 — stream delivery investigation. RoomRevealed confirmed to fire on API side (open_door_test.go). Whether it reaches browser via gRPC-Web is unconfirmed. Use Chrome DevTools on port 9222 (scripts/rpg-chrome.sh) to check Network tab → StreamEncounterEvents → EventStream.
